name: The Wave
notes: Master Builder 6x6 board 'The Wave'. Transcribed by eye (the boardscan/wallscan tools are hardcoded 12x12 and do not run on a 6x6). A clockwise green conveyor loop with left/right wave-bumps, 2 batteries, one westward laser at (5,1), a pit at (3,6), two flag spots at (3,3) and (5,6). Verified in the workshop against the photograph.
